text: {"assertions":["A duplicate charge bug was discovered in billing/webhooks/stripe.py where the webhook consumer created multiple ledger rows for a single event ID.","The root cause of the duplicate charge bug was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) in the ledger table.","The duplicate charge bug was fixed in PR #3099 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1 by adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches.","The duplicate charge bug only manifested on the first request after a cold start.","The duplicate charge bug could be reproduced by redelivering the same webhook ID twice.","The test tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py covers the duplicate charge webhook issue.","After adding the composite index, the flaky test failure rate decreased from 46 failures per 100 runs to zero."]}
